reasons: Creation c. 1969 by an institutional photographer. If unpublished before 2003, a work made for hire runs 120 years from creation.
If first published 1964-1977 without a copyright notice it could be public domain, but no evidence of a 1960s publication, or of its notice status, was found.
The verso documents reproduction in 'Interface', Nov/Dec 1991. Publication after 1 March 1989 does not require a notice, so that publication does not place it in the public domain.
